senses.gloss: रट् vi. 1P (pp. रटित; pres. रटति) 1. To shout, to roar, to yell, पपात राक्षसो भूमौ रराट च भयंकरम् Bt.xiv.81; 2. to call out, to proclaim aloud; 3. to shout with joy, to applaud.With आ-, to call to, प्रियसहचरमपश्यन्त्यातुरा चक्रवाक्यारटति Sak.iv.
रटन n. 1. The act of crying or shouting; 2. a shout of applause or approbation.
